controls.label: Source constraints
controls.description: Shape measurements mapped onto the nucleus. Solid gray marks stereo measurements, blue marks limb outlines, and the grid marks poorly constrained regions.
controls.title: Shape-constraint map

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: The published nucleus shape, simplified for display. Gray is a model material; the grid marks regions with weaker shape constraints.
controls.title: Nucleus shape reconstruction

controls.label: EPOXI photographs
controls.description: EPOXI photographed Hartley’s smooth waist and rough lobes during its 2010 flyby. This mosaic combines MRI views with HRI images restored by the mission team. Original shadows and some restoration grain remain; the grid marks gaps or uncertain shape.
controls.summary: MRI views and restored HRI close-ups show the smooth waist and rough lobes. The photographs retain their shadows; the grid marks gaps or uncertain shape.
controls.title: EPOXI mosaic

controls.label: Color temperature
controls.description: False colors show the temperature fitted to infrared emission. Warm patches within each pixel dominate this measurement. Placement on the shape is approximate; the grid marks gaps.
controls.summary: False colors show the temperature fitted to infrared emission. Warm patches within each pixel dominate this measurement. Placement on the shape is approximate; the grid marks gaps.
controls.title: EPOXI infrared color temperature

controls.label: Infrared slope
controls.description: False colors show how quickly reflected sunlight becomes brighter toward longer infrared wavelengths. Higher values mean a redder spectrum. Placement on the shape is approximate; the grid marks gaps. This does not measure terrain slope or identify minerals.
